combos.name: The Works, with Classic Facial
combos.what: The Classic Facial plus red light therapy plus reflexology, all at the same time while the mask works. So relaxing that people sometimes fall asleep.

combos.name: The Works, with Anti-Aging Facial
combos.what: The Anti-Aging Facial plus red light therapy plus reflexology, all at the same time while the mask works. So relaxing that people sometimes fall asleep.

forPeople.brides: Brides book ahead of the wedding for glowing skin in photos. Microdermabrasion is a favourite before events, and The Works is the full relaxing experience.
forPeople.business: A facial is a calm reset in a busy week — many business clients book daytime appointments.
forPeople.teens: Teen acne care is available in its own teen offering, below the adult services. Adults book first; teens are welcome with a parent.
forPeople.vacation: Book before a vacation so your skin looks its best on the trip.

forSkin.acne: A facial helps acne-prone skin with a thorough deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation and a mask matched to your skin that day. For acne scarring, microneedling is the treatment that helps most.
forSkin.dry: A facial helps dry skin with a gentle deep cleanse, soft exfoliation, warm steam, a custom hydrating mask, and rich serum and moisturizer for deep hydration and a soft, supple feel.
forSkin.dull: A facial helps dull skin with exfoliation and steam to lift away dullness, plus a brightening mask and serum for a fresh, glowing finish. Microdermabrasion is a great add-on for instant brightness.
forSkin.fineLines: An anti-aging facial helps fine lines with firming massage, targeted serums and rich hydration. Microneedling helps over a series of visits.
forSkin.rosacea: A facial helps rosacea-prone skin with a gentle cleanse, calming care and a mask matched to sensitive skin. The esthetician adjusts everything to your skin that day.
forSkin.tired: A facial helps tired skin with deep cleansing, massage, steam and a custom mask — most clients leave looking rested and glowing.

services.feelsLike: Warm, gentle and deeply relaxing. Many clients drift off and wake up glowing.
services.goodFor: Anyone who wants brighter, fresher, more even-looking skin and deep hydration. The perfect foundation for healthy skin, month after month. Perfect for first-timers — every step is explained.
services.name: Classic Facial
services.what: A facial is a one-on-one professional skin treatment for your face, neck and shoulders. The Classic Facial is the signature treatment: a gentle deep cleanse, soft exfoliation, warm relaxing steam, a soothing face, neck and shoulder massage, a custom treatment mask matched to your skin, then serum and moisturizer for a refreshed, finished glow.

services.feelsLike: Eighty full minutes of deep relaxation.
services.goodFor: Anyone noticing fine lines, uneven tone, or skin that looks tired. Fine lines appear softer, skin looks firmer, brighter and more youthful, and feels plump, smooth and deeply nourished.
services.name: Anti-Aging Facial
services.what: Eighty minutes of Circadia anti-aging care. Everything in the Classic Facial, with extended time at every step, plus advanced Circadia anti-aging serums and formulas, firming and lifting facial massage, targeted treatment for fine lines and uneven tone, and rich finishing hydration.

services.feelsLike: Light and gentle — a soft gliding sensation while you relax.
services.goodFor: Plumper, smoother, more radiant skin. Fine lines appear softer and skin tone looks more even.
services.name: NANO Needling
services.what: A 20-minute add-on. Ultra-fine nano tips help professional serums absorb deeply into the skin. It is a gentle infusion, not an injection, and it pairs with any facial.

services.feelsLike: A gentle polishing massage, finished with soothing hydration.
services.goodFor: Skin that feels noticeably smoother right away, a brighter and more even-looking complexion, and makeup that sits more beautifully. A favourite before events and photos.
services.name: Microdermabrasion
services.what: A 15-minute add-on. A polishing wand sweeps away dull surface skin, then a soothing, hydrating finish. A beautiful base for serums and makeup alike. Great before a facial.

services.feelsLike: Warm and peaceful. Many clients nap while the light works.
services.goodFor: Firmer, more youthful-looking skin, a calmer and more even complexion, and better results from any facial.
services.name: Light Therapy
services.what: A 20-minute add-on. You lie back under warm red light for twenty restful minutes. The red light supports collagen, calms skin and evens tone while you rest. It adds to any facial.

services.feelsLike: Gentle, rhythmic pressure — calm spreads through your whole body in minutes.
services.goodFor: Deep relaxation that spreads through the whole body, and a lighter, calmer, more balanced feeling.
services.name: Reflexology
services.what: A 20-minute add-on. Gentle, skilled pressure across the reflex points of the feet. Points on your feet map to your back, neck and shoulders — the arch to the back, the toes to the head and neck — so tender points can show where the body is holding tension. The perfect finishing touch to any facial.

services.feelsLike: A gentle warming sensation as it renews, with expert care throughout.
services.goodFor: Brighter, more even-looking skin tone, smoother texture, fine lines and sun spots appearing softened, and fresh new skin revealed over the following days.
services.name: Chemical Peels
services.what: A chemical peel is a professional Circadia treatment that lifts dull surface layers so fresh, bright skin can emerge. Strengths range from gentle to advanced, and the peel is matched to your skin at a personal consultation. Booked at the $125 starting price; the exact price is confirmed at consultation and any balance is settled at the visit.

services.feelsLike: A professional treatment with expert care and a soothing finish, plus simple aftercare guidance.
services.goodFor: Fine lines looking softer over a series of treatments, acne scarring and uneven texture looking improved, pores looking more refined, and skin looking firmer.
services.name: Microneedling
services.what: Microneedling is also called collagen induction therapy. Fine needles create controlled micro-channels in the skin that prompt your skin's natural repair process and new collagen production. Every plan is custom, built for your skin and goals at consultation. Hold time is 60 minutes.

studio.address: Private studio in Bolton. The exact address is on the booking confirmation only, never read out.
studio.betweenAppointments: 30 minutes for cleaning and prepping the room
studio.bookingWindow: Bookings open from tomorrow up to 60 days ahead.
studio.firstVisit: $10 toward any service on the first visit
studio.giftCertificates: Buy any amount for someone. The code carries a balance, anything left stays on the code, and gift codes never expire.
studio.name: In2Skin
studio.payment: Pay in full by card when you book online (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay). Cash or Interac e-transfer also welcome at the studio. Plain Interac-only debit cards cannot be charged by card, so those clients pay by e-transfer. The charge shows as IN2SKIN on card statements. You can also pay at the visit, on your own phone, with a pay link or QR code.
studio.privateHours: Weekday mornings 7-9 AM, evenings after 7 PM, and Sundays, plus $15 per treatment
studio.referrals: When three friends book and pay in full with your code, you earn $15 treatment credit and a free reflexology add-on. The reward repeats every three referrals. No cash value — credit is for treatments only.
studio.reschedule: Call at least 24 hours ahead to move an appointment, no charge to reschedule.
studio.vouchers: Pay ahead for a named facial plus add-ons and get a code to give as a gift. Any leftover value stays with the person who used the voucher. If the full total is used, the voucher ends when the treatment is completed. No cash value. We suggest enjoying it within 120 days, but the dollar value never expires.
